prompt: A warehouse is shipping orders 30% slower than last year. The candidate's framework: (1) Order volume and mix; (2) Sales forecasts for next holiday season; (3) Picking and packing speed; (4) Shipping and carrier pickup schedules. What is the flaw in this framework?

options.text: Buckets 3 and 4 overlap: packing ends when the carrier picks up
options.feedback: One stage hands off to the other, but work inside the warehouse and carrier pickups are separate stages.

options.text: Missing: how fast workers pull items off the shelves
options.feedback: Pulling items off shelves is picking, bucket 3.

options.text: Bucket 2 doesn't belong: next season's sales can't explain it
options.feedback: Right. A future forecast doesn't explain why shipping is slower now. Replace it with staffing and equipment capacity.

options.text: It's a generic process map: it skips the warehouse software
options.feedback: Software would show up in picking and packing speed. Following the order through the warehouse is the right start. The flaw is bucket 2.

explanation: Slower shipping comes from volume, process speed, capacity and outbound logistics. A forecast for next season isn't a cause.

extras.corrected_framework: Volume and mix; picking and packing; staffing and equipment capacity; outbound logistics
